<script>
(function () {
  // Add to calendar menus: one open at a time; close on outside click or Escape.
  var menus = document.querySelectorAll("details.cal-add");
  menus.forEach(function (d) {
    d.addEventListener("toggle", function () {
      if (d.open) menus.forEach(function (o) { if (o !== d) o.open = false; });
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    menus.forEach(function (d) { if (d.open && !d.contains(e.target)) d.open = false; });
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") menus.forEach(function (d) { d.open = false; });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  // Ceremony day. Counts down to the morning of the wedding.
  var target = new Date(2027, 5, 19, 0, 0, 0).getTime();

  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }

  function tick() {
    var diff = target - Date.now();

    if (diff <= 0) {
      var el = document.getElementById("countdown");
      if (el) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="count-unit" style="min-width:auto">' +
          '<div class="count-num">Today!</div></div>';
      }
      return;
    }

    var s = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
    document.getElementById("cd-days").textContent  = Math.floor(s / 86400);
    document.getElementById("cd-hours").textContent = pad(Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24);
    document.getElementById("cd-mins").textContent  = pad(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60);
    document.getElementById("cd-secs").textContent  = pad(s % 60);

    setTimeout(tick, 1000);
  }

  tick();
})();
</script>
